witness_scope: Synthetic named instances for independently specified contract tests; no empirical source coverage or author approval.

FR-01.positive: One explicitly identified organization and two explicitly distinct facilities linked through two complete FacilityOperation relators yield exactly the two stated operator/site pairs.
FR-01.negative: An organization and facility with the same label or address and no operation link yield no operator/site pair; one individual asserted as both Organization and Facility contradicts their OWL disjointness.
FR-01.boundary: An incomplete operation with no recorded facility yields no query answer; OWL does not entail that no facility exists, while a declared SHACL admission profile rejects the incomplete relator.

FR-02.positive: A named organization typed ManufacturerRole linked by ManufacturingResponsibility to a typed product subject yields the organization, role and responsibility context.
FR-02.negative: A company label without a responsibility relation yields no asserted or entailed role-context answer.
FR-02.boundary: An untyped organization in an asserted ManufacturingResponsibility holder position may infer ManufacturerRole from range, but without the assertion a missing relation stays unknown; SHACL requires the declared counterpart for an admitted responsibility.

FR-03.positive: The same organization-to-site relation is recoverable only when a FacilityOperation instance mediates an OperatingOrganizationRole and an OperatedFacilityRole.
FR-03.negative: Co-location or matching address alone yields no operation relation.
FR-03.boundary: Missing recorded operationFacility stays unknown in query/OWL; a declared SHACL operation admission profile rejects it without making a global negative claim.
